text:
Stuttgart’s median asking rents sit at 15.98 €/m², with a modest year‑on‑year rise of 0.1 % and a five‑year gain of 15.3 %. The market is ranked third among the 37 most expensive German cities, and the asking premium over existing rents is 54 %, while a 60 m² unit costs about 959 € per month.

With a vacancy rate of 1.8 % and an average of 29 days on market, the market remains balanced but tight; 23 % of listings are let within a week. Rent‑burden for two residents stands at 18.3 %, reflecting limited affordability despite a slight population decline of 0.1 % over five years.

The model‑based forecast projects median asking rents of 16.7 €/m² in 12 months, ranging from 16.35 €/m² to 17.22 €/m², implying a 4.5 % increase.
